title: Place value: read, write, value and ten times (the pv kit)

template.also: `pv-support` (`js/modules/pv-support-cell.js`: chart / hundreds-chart / strip pictures beside the frame) and `pv-times` (the same digit one place apart); the generator is `js/modules/gen-pv.js`, the provider `js/modules/sheet/providers/pv.js`; `screen-cell.js` draws the same cell on the practice card, online worksheet and quiz

summary: One numeral per boxed cell at digit size, the asked digit underlined (never highlighted in a filled box), one answer place per item: a write line for a value, a ring for a place, the expanded or unit-form frame with one blank per place (zero places kept), and, for ten times, the same digit drawn one place apart with the relation written as a sentence frame. Paper, key and the three screen hosts are one drawing.
teaches: Reading and writing whole numbers in standard, expanded and unit form; naming the place and the value of a digit; and, from Grade 4, that a digit is worth ten times as much one place to the left and one tenth as much one place to the right. Grades 2-5 (CCSS 2.NBT.A.1, 2.NBT.A.3, 4.NBT.A.1, 4.NBT.A.2, 5.NBT.A.1; WRM Y3.B1, Y5.B1-B2, Y6.B2); comparing two numbers with <, > and = (1.NBT.B.3, 2.NBT.A.4) and finding 1, 10 or 100 more or less (1.NBT.C.5, 2.NBT.B.8).
research: From repo sources: design/research/place-value-rounding.md (P9), design/PROBLEM_TYPES.md PV-04..PV-15, design/catalogue/k2-number-sense-place-value.md (PV ladder, pre-P9), the passed long lessons g2-nbt3-read-write-1000 and g4-nbt1-ten-times-value. MW4K / IXL logins not available in this container (credentials file absent): research rows to be confirmed.
problemTypes: PV-09 place and value of a marked digit: ring the place name (identify) or write the value (value)
PV-06 expanded / standard form: write the expanded form with one blank per place, zero place kept (expand); combine the parts into a numeral (combine)
PV-07 unit form and renaming: '__ hundreds __ tens __ ones'; '34 tens = __' (unit_form)
PV-14 / PV-15 x10 / ÷10: the same digit one place apart, '700 is 10 times 70', 'one tenth of 700 is __' (place_value_10x and the ten-times presets)
PV-04 compare two numbers: write <, > or = in the circle between them; the first place that differs decides, a longer number is bigger (compare)
PV-05 1 / 10 / 100 more or less: write the number that is 1, 10 or 100 more or less, or the start it came from (more_less_10, more_less_100)
progression: 2-digit, then 3-digit numbers with no zero; the place letters H T O over the digits
a zero place dealt on purpose (405, 350): the zero is written, never dropped
4-digit and larger with the comma; the letters fade, the digit boxes stay
ten times: the same digit one place left; then one tenth one place right; then 'how many times as many' (700 ÷ 70 = 10)
compare: far apart, same length; then close (same first digit); then different lengths; '=' dealt one item in six
1 / 10 / 100 more or less: the answer missing, with a hundreds-chart strip or a number line; then no support; then the start missing; crossing a 9 or a 0 last

drawing.sizes: digits 16 / 22 / 28 pt (tokens.js SIZES); write lines and blanks sized from the widest possible answer (L3); default size L.
notes: Payload (`q.cell = {template: 'pv', v: 1, payload}`): `kind` (place, place-bank, value, blanks, expand, expand-line, frame), `n`, `place`, `frame`, `keys`, `keyValue`, `words`, `bigNumerals`.
The marked digit is underlined, never filled (catalogue: a filled box prints black). The key writes every answer in place in the key ink.

compares the last digits, or the first digits of numbers of different lengths

does not regroup across a 9 or a 0
